name: @papercusp/desktop
description: Tauri desktop shell for Papercusp. Spawns the Node sidecar and embeds the web UI.

scripts.test: npm run test:config && npm run test:shell && npm run test:selftests
scripts.test:shell: node --test test/claim-target-dir.test.js test/tauri-dev-slot-chokepoint.test.js test/tauri-guarded-missing-cli-diagnostic.test.js test/build-desktop-sidecar-lock.test.js test/build-desktop-sidecar-workspace-install.test.js test/build-desktop-sidecar-onnx-gpu-providers.test.js test/dev-operator-ifneeded-reaper.test.js test/dev-operator-perf-env.test.js test/build-deb-stale-sidecar-guard.test.js test/build-deb-placeholder-sidecar-guard.test.js test/build-deb-bundle-lock-path.test.js test/build-deb-build-timeout.test.js test/build-deb-signing-key.test.js test/repack-deb-xz.test.js test/installed-app-tree.test.js test/sidecar-stray-cache-guard.test.js test/build-script-bundle-scope.test.js test/spa-freshness-guard.test.js test/sidecar-freshness-guard.test.js test/sidecar-no-database-bake-guard.test.js test/updater-e2e-vm.test.js test/fed-driver-sql-output.test.js test/release-identity-scan-archives.test.js test/release-identity-case-insensitive.test.js test/release-upload-content-skip.test.js test/release-sidecar-prune-and-scrub.test.js test/nightly-channel-identity.test.js test/release-local-precheck-exit.test.js test/build-windows-identity.test.js test/appimage-glfallback-guard.test.js test/provenance-sidecar-record.test.js test/provenance-release-host-record.test.js test/verification-script-verdict-guard.test.js test/mac-vm-health.test.js test/test-registry-coverage.test.js
scripts.bindings: cd src-tauri && cargo build --quiet && (cargo run --quiet 2>/dev/null & PID=$!; sleep 4; kill $PID 2>/dev/null; wait $PID 2>/dev/null; true) && echo '✓ tauri-bindings.ts regenerated'
